description: Display-only categories. The four markets_*.json pages are real Polymarket US public market data recorded 2026-10-10T18:50Z with curl from https://gateway.polymarket.us, unchanged (display prices come from their bestAskQuote and bestBidQuote, so no book is requested). The macro page and its two books reuse the SYNTHETIC files of ../synthetic (one same and one opposite pair with kalshi/categories), so a match run over this scenario has a Fed pair present. The sports page always answers 429 with the rate_limited body (fault).
